gaps: Division leaders named only in local business journals, HBA/BIA rosters or conference speaker lists: not checked. This file rests on the company's own press releases (285 releases, Jan 2024 to Nov 18 2026, plus 2021-2023 for tenure), the FY2025 10-K, the 2026 proxy, the company website and a few third-party pages.

Division- and region-level land leaders (VP / Director of Land Acquisition, Land Development, Entitlement): none named in any company release, filing or website page reviewed; the company's land page is a submission form with no named contacts. Not found, not confirmed absent.

Reporting lines are not published. The 10-K says land deals are sourced by local management and approved by the corporate office above set limits. The Nov 9 2026 release says Jim Francescon (EVP Corporate Operations; President from Jan 1 2027) oversees homebuilding operations and land, so regional presidents probably report to him or to CEO Rob Francescon; left blank rather than guessed.

Dallas-Fort Worth: leader of the combined Century / HistoryMaker Homes division (Grapevine) not named. The Oct 8 2026 release says HistoryMaker division leadership joins Century; it does not say whether HistoryMaker CEO Nelson Mitchell stays. Jabez Development (HistoryMaker's sister land developer) keeps an ongoing land development relationship with Century in DFW.
Las Vegas: no division president named by the company since 2024; only an unconfirmed third-party directory name.

Utah: division president last named Feb 2025. Southern California: area president last named Apr 2025, division president Sep 2025. Jacksonville: division president last named Sep 2025. None reconfirmed in 2026 company releases.
Charlotte / Carolinas: division name for Chris Suttles not stated; a 'Regional President, Mid-Atlantic' (Charlotte) role was advertised around Jan 2026 and the hire, if any, is not public.
West region: no California-wide or West regional president confirmed; Kevin Kimball's region beyond Washington is not stated.
National President of the Century Communities brand: Liesel Cooper was last quoted in that title in Jan 2024; no 2025 or 2026 confirmation, so no row.

Century Complete: no division-level leaders named for North Carolina (Triad, Triangle, Wilmington, Greenville), Alabama (Birmingham, Huntsville, Enterprise), Georgia (Macon, Columbus), Central / Gulf Coast / Treasure Coast Florida, Tucson, Pahrump NV, or the Michigan, Indiana and Kentucky markets beyond the regional president.

Northern Colorado, Raleigh/Durham and Huntsville (Century Communities brand): no separate division leader named; they appear to sit under the Colorado, Carolinas and Nashville teams respectively (not confirmed).
Phones and emails: no division or regional contact details are published.
